title: EAPRO 550W Monocrystalline Half-Cut Solar Panel, 144 Half Cells, Anodized Aluminium Frame, for Home, Commercial & Off-Grid Inverter Systems
description: The EAPRO 550W Monocrystalline Half-Cut Solar Panel is engineered for maximum power generation and long-term reliability. Featuring 144 half-cut Mono PERC cells with M10 182mm wafers, this panel delivers a module efficiency of up to 21.8%, making it one of the most productive options available for rooftop and ground-mount installations. The half-cut cell design significantly reduces resistive losses and improves performance under partial shading conditions, ensuring consistent energy output throughout the day. Built with anti-reflective tempered glass, dual EVA encapsulation layers, a weatherproof backsheet, and a sturdy anodised aluminium frame, this panel withstands wind and snow loads of up to 5400Pa. It is fully compatible with all major solar inverters and tall tubular batteries, making it ideal for home, commercial, and off-grid systems. Dimensions are approximately 2278 x 1134 x 35 mm. Backed by a 12-year product warranty and a 25-year linear power warranty, the EAPRO 550W panel is a dependable investment for sustainable, long-term energy independence.
